channel.title: CW Headlines · 25 WPM
channel.description: The day's top ten news stories, sent in Morse code, at 25 WPM. A new edition every morning: ten short summaries of the top stories on the BBC News front page, sent as clean 600 Hz CW. The full plain-text copy is in each episode's notes so you can check what you copied. Not affiliated with the BBC.

item.title: 31 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 31 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:19 NR 1 THE US HAS APPROVED SELLING 500 PATRIOT INTERCEPTOR MISSILES TO UKRAINE, THE ONLY EFFECTIVE DEFENCE AGAINST RUSSIAN BALLISTIC MISSILES. <BT> Story

1:17 NR 2 PRIME MINISTER BURNHAM SAYS HE IS OPEN TO A UK APOLOGY FOR THE TRANSATLANTIC SLAVE TRADE, BUT REJECTS PAYING REPARATIONS. <BT> Story

2:10 NR 3 SUSPECTED NORTH KOREAN HACKERS ARE THE MAIN SUSPECTS IN A RECORD-BREAKING THEFT FROM THE CRYPTO EXCHANGE BINANCE. <BT> Story

2:59 NR 4 HOME SECRETARY MAHMOOD IS EXPECTED TO CHANGE INDEFINITE LEAVE TO REMAIN RULES FOR MIGRANT WORKERS, DESPITE OPPOSITION INSIDE THE GOVERNMENT. <BT> Story

3:58 NR 5 THE SECOND SERIES OF CELEBRITY TRAITORS ENDED ON FRIDAY WITH A TENSE FINAL, AFTER DRAWING 15 MILLION VIEWERS. <BT> Story

4:44 NR 6 POLICE WERE SENT IN AMID A STANDOFF OVER POLAND'S TOP COURT, AFTER THE GOVERNMENT SUSPENDED TWO SENIOR JUDGES AND SOUGHT CRIMINAL CHARGES. <BT> Story

5:45 NR 7 KARL BUSHBY, WHO SET OFF TO WALK AROUND THE WORLD 28 YEARS AGO, IS NEARLY HOME AFTER COVERING 36,000 MILES. <BT> Story

6:38 NR 8 THE G20 GROUP PHOTO WAS SCRAPPED AFTER PROTESTS OVER RUSSIA'S MINISTER, WHOM UK FOREIGN SECRETARY ED MILIBAND ACCUSED OF KILLING UKRAINIAN CIVILIANS. <BT> Story

7:46 NR 9 TALK OF AN EARLY GENERAL ELECTION CONTINUES AMONG MPS AT WESTMINSTER, EVEN THOUGH PRIME MINISTER BURNHAM HAS FIRMLY RULED ONE OUT. <BT> Story

8:41 NR 10 INTERNATIONAL TALKS ON HALTING THE DECLINE OF NATURE HAVE REACHED AN AGREEMENT, BUT QUESTIONS OVER FUNDING REMAIN UNRESOLVED. <AR> Story

item.title: 30 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 30 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:19 NR 1 CRYPTO FIRM BINANCE SUFFERS WHAT IS CALLED THE LARGEST HACK EVER, WITH TWO ANALYTICS FIRMS BLAMING NORTH KOREAN HACKING UNIT TRADERTRAITOR. <BT> Story

1:20 NR 2 ERIN PATTERSON, CONVICTED IN THE AUSTRALIAN MUSHROOM MURDER CASE, LOSES HER APPEAL AFTER THREE JUDGES REJECT ALL SEVEN GROUNDS OF UNFAIRNESS. <BT> Story

2:20 NR 3 HYROX ATHLETE JOANNA WIETRZYK, WHO SOILED HERSELF DURING A RACE, ACCEPTS RESPONSIBILITY AND SAYS SHE PUT OTHERS AT RISK BUT FACED EXCESSIVE BACKLASH. <BT> Story

3:26 NR 4 WHATEVER THE MIDTERM RESULTS, DEMOCRATS FACE HARD QUESTIONS ABOUT WHAT THE PARTY STANDS FOR AND WHO SHOULD REPRESENT IT. <BT> Story

4:18 NR 5 GOOGLE LOSES 500 BILLION DOLLARS IN MARKET VALUE, ITS SHARES HITTING A SIX-MONTH LOW AFTER IT SAID AI SEARCH SUMMARIES WERE HURTING AD REVENUE. <BT> Story

5:19 NR 6 THE PENULTIMATE EPISODE OF THE TRAITORS FEATURES A DRAMATIC CONFESSION AS THE FAITHFUL PLAYERS FINALLY START TO APPLY PRESSURE. <BT> Story

6:13 NR 7 LEAKED AUDIO FROM THE SPAIN TRAIN CRASH SUGGESTS A TRAIN WAS CLEARED TO PROCEED BY A CONTROL CENTRE ALTHOUGH ANOTHER HAD STALLED ON THE TRACK. <BT> Story

7:13 NR 8 BBC VERIFY LOOKS AT THE COST OF THE WELFARE SYSTEM AND THE OPTIONS THE GOVERNMENT HAS FOR CUTTING SPENDING ON IT. <BT> Story

8:01 NR 9 ISRAELI OPPOSITION ACCUSES NETANYAHU OF UNDERMINING THE ELECTION, AFTER HIS LIKUD PARTY ALLEGED FOREIGN INTERFERENCE WHEN HIS COALITION LOST ITS MAJORITY. <BT> Story

9:08 NR 10 IN SERBIA, NEWLY ELECTED STUDENT LIST MPS CALL FOR TOP FIGURES TO RESIGN, DAYS AFTER REMOVING ALEKSANDAR VUCIC'S PARTY FROM POWER. <AR> Story

item.title: 29 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 29 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:19 NR 1 CHANCELLOR HEALEY'S FIRST BUDGET OFFERS 100 POUNDS TOWARD ENERGY BILLS AND A TAX ON BANKS, BUT OPPOSITION PARTIES CALL IT TOO TIMID. <BT> Story

1:20 NR 2 SPAIN STARTS THREE DAYS OF MOURNING AFTER A TRAIN CRASH KILLED DOZENS, ONE OF THE WORST EUROPEAN RAIL DISASTERS IN MODERN TIMES. <BT> Story

2:14 NR 3 PARTIAL RESULTS FROM THE ISRAELI ELECTION, WITH 85 PERCENT COUNTED, GIVE NETANYAHU'S LIKUD AND ALLIES 53 OF 120 KNESSET SEATS, SHORT OF A MAJORITY. <BT> Story

3:20 NR 4 DEFEATED BRAZILIAN CANDIDATE FLAVIO BOLSONARO LANDS IN MIAMI AND DENIES FLEEING, REPEATING UNPROVEN CLAIMS OF A COUP AND ELECTORAL FRAUD AGAINST HIM. <BT> Story

4:24 NR 5 POLICE CLOSE THEIR INQUIRY AFTER THE AUGUST DEATH OF HEROES AND NASHVILLE ACTRESS HAYDEN PANETTIERE, FROM FENTANYL, XANAX AND OTHER DRUGS, IS RULED ACCIDENTAL. <BT> Story

5:32 NR 6 ITEMS LINKED TO GEORGE MICHAEL, INCLUDING HIS FAITH GUITAR, ARE GOING TO AUCTION, BUT THE BROTHER OF HIS LATE ASSISTANT SAYS SHE WOULD HAVE OBJECTED. <BT> Story

6:36 NR 7 ON THE SECOND DAY OF HIS CARIBBEAN TOUR, KING CHARLES HONOURS FALLEN SERVICE MEMBERS ON THE ISLAND AND LATER SHOWS OFF HIS DANCING. <BT> Story

7:33 NR 8 HACKERS CALLING THEMSELVES THE DEPARTMENT OF PEACE PUBLISH DETAILS OF OVER 41,000 DHS EMPLOYEES, INCLUDING THOUSANDS OF US IMMIGRATION AGENTS. <BT> Story

8:38 NR 9 A CONSTRUCTION SURGE IN PARTS OF NEPAL AND INDIA'S UTTARAKHAND HAS PUT 300,000 PEOPLE AT RISK FROM POTENTIAL HIMALAYAN DISASTERS. <BT> Story

9:39 NR 10 RECYCLING INDUSTRY LEADERS WARN THAT USED NEEDLES ARE TURNING UP MORE OFTEN IN HOUSEHOLD WASTE AS WEIGHT-LOSS INJECTIONS GROW IN POPULARITY. <AR> Story

item.title: 28 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 28 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:19 NR 1 EXIT POLLS IN ISRAEL'S GENERAL ELECTION SHOW BENJAMIN NETANYAHU AND FORMER MILITARY CHIEF GADI EISENKOT TIED, WITH NEITHER PROJECTED TO WIN A MAJORITY. <BT> Story

1:23 NR 2 JOHN HEALEY'S FIRST BUDGET IS EXPECTED TO FOCUS ON COST OF LIVING SUPPORT, PARTICULARLY ENERGY BILLS, ALONG WITH ANNOUNCEMENTS ON DEVOLUTION. <BT> Story

2:29 NR 3 FLAVIO BOLSONARO, THE DEFEATED BRAZILIAN PRESIDENTIAL CANDIDATE, HAS ARRIVED IN THE US HOURS AFTER FAILING TO HAND OVER HIS PASSPORTS, WHICH BRAZIL CANCELLED. <BT> Story

3:38 NR 4 THE KING BEGINS A NINE-DAY CARIBBEAN TOUR OF THE BAHAMAS, GUYANA AND ANTIGUA AND BARBUDA, ACKNOWLEDGING PAST SUFFERING AS IT OPENS. <BT> Story

4:36 NR 5 CALMER WEATHER FOLLOWS THE RECENT STORMS ACROSS THE UK, BUT THICK FOG AND MIST COULD MAKE DRIVING DANGEROUS FOR COMMUTERS THIS WEEK. <BT> Story

5:34 NR 6 NEIL YOUNG IS SUING THE TRUMP CAMPAIGN AGAIN FOR PLAYING ROCKIN' IN THE FREE WORLD AT A RALLY, AFTER A SIMILAR LAWSUIT IN 2020. <BT> Story

6:31 NR 7 MPS WARN THAT SWITCHING UK LANDLINES TO DIGITAL BY JANUARY COULD LEAVE REMOTE AREAS UNABLE TO CALL FOR HELP IN AN EMERGENCY. <BT> Story

7:26 NR 8 THE ALEXANDER BROTHERS, FORMERLY HIGH-PROFILE US REAL ESTATE MOGULS, HAVE EACH BEEN SENTENCED TO 30 YEARS IN PRISON IN A SEX TRAFFICKING CASE. <BT> Story

8:28 NR 9 PASSENGERS ON THE LUXURY CRUISE SHIP VILLA VIE ODYSSEY ARE STRANDED IN CAMBODIA AFTER SOARING FUEL COSTS FORCED THE VOYAGE TO BE SUSPENDED. <BT> Story

9:28 NR 10 UTAH AUTHORITIES USED ADVANCED DNA TECHNOLOGY TO LINK SERIAL KILLER TED BUNDY TO THE MURDER OF A TEENAGE GIRL 52 YEARS AGO. <AR> Story

item.title: 27 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 27 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:19 NR 1 ISRAELIS VOTE IN A PIVOTAL ELECTION CENTRED ON SECURITY AND DEMOCRACY, AMID FEARS NEITHER MAIN BLOC WILL WIN A MAJORITY. <BT> Story

1:11 NR 2 WITH THE BUDGET CLOSE, BURNHAM FACES A GROWING PILE OF DIFFICULT ISSUES, FROM BREXIT DEBATES TO NORTH SEA OIL. <BT> Story

2:00 NR 3 THE CHANCELLOR WILL SCRAP TARIFFS ON SOME STAPLE GOODS TO EASE COST OF LIVING PRESSURE ON HOUSEHOLDS. <BT> Story

2:46 NR 4 HARRY KANE WINS THE MEN'S BALLON D'OR, THE FIRST ENGLISH WINNER SINCE MICHAEL OWEN IN 2001, WHILE ALEXIA PUTELLAS WINS A THIRD WOMEN'S AWARD. <BT> Story

3:50 NR 5 JAMES COMEY, FORMER FBI CHIEF, FACES A THIRD SET OF FEDERAL CHARGES, LINKED TO ALLEGED 2016 DISCLOSURES OF CLASSIFIED MATERIAL TO THE NEW YORK TIMES. <BT> Story

4:57 NR 6 SALES OF TORCHES, RADIOS AND POWER BANKS HAVE JUMPED SHARPLY AFTER THE GOVERNMENT URGED PEOPLE TO STOCK UP ON ESSENTIALS. <BT> Story

5:50 NR 7 JAY-Z WILL PERFORM AT THE SUPER BOWL HALF-TIME SHOW FOR THE FIRST TIME, DESPITE YEARS OF INVOLVEMENT WITH THE EVENT. <BT> Story

6:41 NR 8 STORM BOELO LEAVES THOUSANDS WITHOUT POWER, AS A YELLOW WIND WARNING COVERS WESTERN COASTS OF ENGLAND, WALES AND SCOTLAND AND EASTERN NORTHERN IRELAND. <BT> Story

7:48 NR 9 A CEASEFIRE ANNOUNCED BY MELANIA TRUMP BEGINS IN A WAR-HIT UKRAINIAN CITY, AIMING TO ALLOW AID DELIVERIES AND CIVILIAN EVACUATIONS. <BT> Story

8:44 NR 10 APPLE SAYS IT WILL REPLACE IPHONE DUO HANDSETS, ITS FIRST FOLDABLE PHONE, AFTER PHOTOS ONLINE SHOWED SCREEN FAULTS. <AR> Story

item.title: 26 Oct 2026 · 25 WPM
item.description:
0:01 VVV VVV <BT> CW HEADLINES 26 OCT 2026 <BT>

0:18 NR 1 PRESIDENT LULA OF BRAZIL IS RE-ELECTED FOR A FOURTH TERM, EDGING OUT RIGHT-WING CHALLENGER FLAVIO BOLSONARO, SON OF THE FORMER PRESIDENT, IN A CLOSE VOTE. <BT> Story

1:28 NR 2 STORM BOELO CUTS POWER TO ABOUT 90,000 PROPERTIES ACROSS SCOTLAND AND NORTHERN ENGLAND, AND THE MET OFFICE HAS ISSUED A FRESH WIND WARNING. <BT> Story

2:32 NR 3 HEALEY PLANS TO KEEP LOWER-INCOME PENSIONERS OUT OF INCOME TAX IN THE BUDGET, AS THE FULL STATE PENSION IS DUE TO RISE IN APRIL. <BT> Story

3:26 NR 4 A DAUGHTER WHO LOOKED AFTER HER ELDERLY MOTHER AT HOME WINS A CLAIM OF 127,000 POUNDS, AFTER A PAINFUL DISPUTE WITH HER SIBLINGS. <BT> Story

4:25 NR 5 LONDON'S OXFORD STREET HAS BEEN PEDESTRIANISED, AND THE FIRST PHASE OF THE WORK IS DUE TO FINISH BY SPRING 2027. <BT> Story

5:15 NR 6 SENIOR CONSULTANT DOCTORS IN ENGLAND WILL STRIKE FOR 48 HOURS FROM 25 NOVEMBER IN A DISPUTE OVER PAY AND PENSIONS. <BT> Story

6:07 NR 7 SERBIA CELEBRATES AS VETERAN LEADER ALEKSANDAR VUCIC CONCEDES DEFEAT TO A STUDENT-LED PROTEST MOVEMENT AFTER 12 YEARS IN POWER. <BT> Story

7:00 NR 8 PRIME MINISTER BURNHAM DOES NOT RULE OUT A REFERENDUM ON EU FREE MOVEMENT AND WANTS A DEBATE ON THE UK'S FUTURE TIES WITH EUROPE. <BT> Story

7:52 NR 9 VENEZUELAN OPPOSITION LEADER MARIA MACHADO RETURNS TO CHEERING CROWDS AFTER MORE THAN TEN MONTHS IN EXILE, HAVING FLED THE COUNTRY BY SPEEDBOAT. <BT> Story

8:54 NR 10 PRINCE WILLIAM SAYS KNIGHTING RUGBY LEAGUE STAR KEVIN SINFIELD WAS AN EASY DECISION, ADDING THE HONOUR SHOULD HAVE COME YEARS AGO. <AR> Story
